title: Tourism Destination Management
duration: 45 hours (30 hours of lectures and 15 hours of seminars/practicals)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the fundamental concepts, nature, importance, and characteristics of tourism destinations and destination management organizations (DMOs).

Analyze and develop strategies for tourism destination development, including environmental analysis, macro-environment analysis, competitive analysis, vision setting, goal setting, and solution development for destination development.
Understand and apply knowledge related to positioning and branding of tourism destinations, market segmentation, target market selection, and destination marketing mix.
Evaluate the sustainability of tourism destinations and apply quality management practices to enhance the visitor experience.
Analyze the components of a tourism destination, business environment, and marketing tools.
Demonstrate the ability to self-learn, update knowledge, and be creative in work.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve problems related to tourism destination management.
Develop and deliver effective presentations on tourism destination management topics.
Work effectively in teams to complete group assignments and presentations.
Communicate effectively in both written and oral formats.
